race.comment: RING OF FIRE (4) has the most persuasive recent profile, with a close Canberra second two runs back after being held up and a last-start seventh, when well found in betting. Barrier one helps him conserve ground, and his season record reads strongly for this grade. DELAGO SERG (5) is the immediate danger on the quick back-up after a tough fourth at the Sapphire Coast and a prior Class 3 run at this venue, with enough race fitness now to make his presence felt. HARD GRUNT (6) rises from a Tumut BM50 placing but gets weight relief, has already won at this track and beat Fulmina's Legacy at Bombala two starts ago. BIG TIME CHARLIE (2) was only fair first-up at this track, yet his two wins and one placing from three starts at this track and distance keep him in the mix if he sharpens second-up.
